name: Abercrombie & Fitch
outlook:
What Abercrombie & Fitch says to expect

  • Third quarter 2026: outlookThird quarter outlook of net sales growth of 5% to 6%, net income per diluted share of $2.90 to $3.20, at least $100 million in share repurchases
  • Full year 2026: outlookUpdates full-year outlook to net sales growth of around 5%, net income per diluted share of $13.10 to $13.60, share repurchases increased to at least $500 million
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed August 26, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
